Title: Workforce Analytics Manager
Description: Workforce Intelligence, Business Analytics & Strategic Planning 📍 Guadalajara, Jalisco, México 📍 Tijuana, B.C. Mexico 🏢 On-Site 🕒 Full-Time Help Build the Intelligence Behind the Mission At FLF, exceptional business decisions begin with exceptional data. As our organization continues to grow, we rely on workforce analytics, business intelligence, and operational insights to optimize performance, improve efficiency, and support strategic decision-making across the firm. We are seeking an experienced Workforce Analytics Manager to transform workforce data into actionable business intelligence that empowers leaders, improves organizational performance, and helps shape the future of our operations. If you're passionate about analytics, workforce planning, business intelligence, and helping leaders make smarter decisions through data, we'd love to hear from you. Why This Role Matters As our Workforce Analytics Manager, you will serve as the firm's trusted advisor for workforce intelligence and operational reporting. You'll design executive dashboards, analyze workforce trends, develop forecasting models, and provide strategic recommendations that help leadership optimize staffing, improve productivity, and support sustainable growth. Your work will directly influence workforce planning, organizational performance, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making. Compensation & Benefits USD Salary Compensation paid twice a month Performance-based bonus opportunities Career growth within a rapidly expanding organization Ongoing professional development and technical training Exposure to executive leadership and strategic business initiatives Collaborative and data-driven work environment Modern office located in Guadalajara's premier financial district What You'll Do Workforce Analytics & Business Intelligence Design, develop, and maintain workforce dashboards and executive reporting solutions. Analyze workforce utilization, productivity, staffing capacity, attendance, and operational performance. Transform complex workforce data into meaningful insights and strategic recommendations. Develop scorecards and reporting frameworks that provide leadership with clear operational visibility. Workforce Planning & Forecasting Build workforce forecasting models that support staffing decisions and organizational growth. Analyze historical trends to identify future workforce needs and resource requirements. Partner with department leaders to evaluate workforce utilization and staffing capacity. Support long-term workforce planning initiatives through quantitative analysis. Performance Measurement & Operational Insights Evaluate workforce performance metrics, operational KPIs, and productivity measures. Conduct root-cause analysis to identify opportunities for operational improvement. Recommend enhancements to reporting methodologies and performance measurement frameworks. Monitor organizational trends and communicate key findings to executive leadership. Reporting Automation & Data Governance Continuously improve reporting processes, dashboard functionality, and analytics capabilities. Develop standardized reporting definitions and governance practices. Collaborate with Technology, Operations, and Data teams to enhance reporting automation. Identify opportunities to leverage technology and AI to improve reporting efficiency and scalability. Strategic Business Partnership Partner with executive leadership to support strategic planning and operational decision-making. Present analytical findings and recommendations in a clear, concise, and business-focused manner. Support special projects, organizational initiatives, and executive reporting requests. Serve as a trusted advisor on workforce analytics, organizational performance, and business intelligence. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Operations Management, Information Systems, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in workforce analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or related analytical roles. Advanced experience developing executive dashboards and reporting solutions. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills. Advanced proficiency with Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar business intelligence platforms. Experience building workforce reports, dashboards, and forecasting models. Professional proficiency in English and Spanish with strong presentation and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in a related discipline. Experience within legal services, professional services, healthcare, or high-growth organizations. Experience with Time Doctor or workforce productivity platforms. Knowledge of SQL, data visualization, or reporting automation. Experience supporting executive leadership with strategic reporting and workforce planning. Professional certifications in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, or Workforce Planning. The Type of Person Who Thrives Here Our Most Successful Team Members Are Curious, analytical, and business-minded Strategic thinkers who transform data into action Highly organized and detail-oriented Strong communicators who simplify complex information Collaborative partners who influence through insight Continuous learners who embrace innovation and technology Accountable professionals focused on measurable outcomes Why Join FLF? At FLF, analytics are more than reports—they're a strategic advantage. You'll partner directly with executive leadership, influence organizational strategy, and help build the reporting infrastructure that supports one of the fastest-growing Personal Injury Law Firms. As we continue to invest in technology, business intelligence, and operational excellence, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our workforce and organizational performance. About FLF FLF is a growing Personal Injury Law Firm dedicated to helping injured individuals and their families obtain the justice and compensation they deserve. Our success is driven by talented professionals across legal, client services, business operations, and marketing who work together to deliver exceptional results. We believe that when great people, meaningful data, and sound decision-making come together, extraordinary outcomes follow. Our Core Values Loyalty – To our clients, our team, and our mission. Trust – Building confidence through transparency, consistency, and results. Respect – For clients, colleagues, and the communities we serve. Accountability – Taking responsibility for outcomes, both successes and mistakes. Continuous Growth – Striving to learn, adapt, and improve daily. Equal Opportunity Employer FLF is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all team members. Ready to Apply? If you're excited about using data to drive smarter business decisions, improve workforce performance, and influence organizational strategy, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your resume along with a brief summary of a workforce analytics dashboard, business intelligence initiative, or forecasting project you developed, including the business impact your analysis helped achieve.

Title: Anaplan Model Builder
Description: About Slalom’s Enterprise Capability At the heart of Slalom’s Enterprise Capability is a bold ambition: to design and deliver intelligent, human-centered business applications that empower organizations to serve their customers with acceleration, agility, precision, and purpose. We partner with leading platforms—Salesforce, ServiceNow, Adobe, Anaplan, Workday, Contentful, Boomi, Workato and more—to build scalable, end-to-end solutions that unify data, streamline operations, and unlock actionable insights. Our work powers everything from smarter CRM experiences and next-gen commerce sites to resilient case management systems and optimized workforce planning. But we're not just technologists—we’re strategic enablers. Whether helping a client modernize their infrastructure, integrate mission-critical functions, or activate AI-powered innovation, we connect strategy to execution in ways that drive measurable impact. Here, you’ll collaborate with curious, courageous people who believe in growth through experimentation, delivering value through partnerships, and building a future where technology works quietly in service of extraordinary outcomes. Who You’ll Work With At Slalom, we’re continuing to grow our Anaplan practice in LATAM, expanding the team and capabilities we can bring to clients across the region and globally. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing practice, work alongside experienced Anaplan professionals, and help shape how we deliver Anaplan solutions from LATAM. What You’ll Do Translate existing solutions, complex spreadsheets, and business challenges into elegant and intuitive Anaplan multidimensional models. Design, build, and enhance Anaplan models as part of new implementations, connected solutions, optimizations, or expanded functionality. Partner with clients and internal teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Anaplan solutions. Provide clear, meaningful feedback and timely progress updates to business partners and project teams. Develop and maintain model documentation. Participate in data integration and migration activities. Support and lead UAT testing and deployment activities. Collaborate with the broader Anaplan team and contribute to the continued growth of Slalom’s Anaplan capabilities in LATAM. What You’ll Bring Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, MIS, or a related field. 3+ years of experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions, including at least one Anaplan implementation. Hands-on experience designing, building, or implementing Anaplan models. Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills. Understanding of system implementation methodologies, including requirements gathering, design, build, testing, and deployment. Experience with Agile methodologies is preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills . A collaborative, client-focused approach and commitment to service excellence. Subject matter expertise in planning and modeling within Supply Chain, Finance, or Sales is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of inbound and outbound data integrations. Passion for business analytics, modeling, and planning. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A hands-on, “roll-up-your-sleeves” mindset and enthusiasm for working within a growing team. Interest in gaining exposure across industries while continuing to develop your Anaplan and consulting expertise. About Us Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

Title: Coordinador De Originación De Crédito
Description: ¡Sé parte del futuro de Brades Card como Coordinador de Originación de Crédito! ¿Estás en búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento? Esta es tu oportunidad para destacar y crecer en una empresa con más de 10 años de éxito en México y respaldada por el prestigio de Bradesco, uno de los bancos más importantes de América Latina.EnBrades Card , buscamos unCoordinador de Originación de Crédito,quien será el encargado de diseñar y optimizar estrategias de crédito en la etapa de originación, basada en el análisis de datos y con el objetivo de maximizar la rentabilidad de la EmpresaUbicación: Guadalajara, Zona las FuentesHorario: L-V 8:30am a 5:30pmLo que harás: Desarrollar y optimizar políticas de crédito con el objetivo de mitigar las pérdidas y aumentar los ingresos de manera responsableRealizar gestión del riesgo crediticio (flujo de originación de crédito, asignación de límites de crédito, aprobación segmentada por perfiles de riesgo)Monitorear el desempeño de las políticas de crédito, identificar oportunidades y desencadenar acciones correctivas y/o producir informes según correspondaDocumentar y comunicar resultados de una forma sencilla y claraGestionar el proceso de incorporación de fuentes alternativas de información para robustecer los modelos de originación, simplificando los procesos de crédito y perfilando mejor a los clientesGestionar un equipo de especialistas de crédito, por lo que necesitará habilidades de comunicación efectiva y capacidad para tomar decisiones¿Qué ofrecemos? Plan de carrera en una empresa que valora el crecimiento profesional y personal de sus colaboradores. Beneficios adicionales: Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores, Seguro Dental y Seguro de Vida.Lo que buscamos en ti: Titulado en Actuaría, Sistemas, Ingeniería Industrial, Matemáticas, Estadistica, Economía, Finanzas ó Informática Administrativa Experiencia: 3 años en originación de crédito Experiencia En Instituciones Financieras o BancosHabilidades y Conocimientos Requeridos ° Conocimientos sólidos en análisis de riesgos y políticas de crédito +2 años (preferentemente: tarjetas de crédito). Capacidad de extraer la esencia de información compleja y explicarla de forma sencilla. Fuerte experiencia en la toma de decisiones basadas en datos. Comprensión de modelos de originación (preferentemente: tarjetas de crédito). Capacidad de planificar adecuadamente para cumplir múltiples objetivos. Contar con habilidades sólidas de liderazgo y capacidad para gestionar equipos de trabajo.
